name: ui-chip
description: Bootstrap 6 chips: themed, active, toggle, link, avatar, icon, dot, dismissible; chip input with Mail.app-style selection, form value and the data API.

descriptions.--bs-chip-gap: Space between avatar / icon, text and remove button.
descriptions.--bs-chip-dismiss-hover-opacity: Opacity of the remove button on hover.
descriptions.--bs-chip-input-padding-y: Vertical padding of the chip input.
descriptions.--bs-chip-input-padding-x: Horizontal padding of the chip input.
descriptions.--bs-chip-input-gap: Space between chips in the chip input.
descriptions.--bs-chip-input-ghost-min-width: Minimum width of the text field in the chip input.
